hypothesis: The exact MU 15m breakout-pressure route may add a repeatable source-native edge after finite-depth fills, fees, funding, latency, stop behavior, and one-position-per-route lifecycle accounting.
decision: Keep MU report-only with no v52 live change. Exact 0xArchive mark evidence repaired 14 of 15 prospective mark gaps and reduced technical censoring from eight episodes to two, but the stronger replay still fails robustness: all five completed lifecycles are long, the only short remains censored, and stress net excluding the largest winner is -$37.33. Continue exact prospective collection rather than retuning or promoting a winner-dependent one-sided sample.
falsifier: Reject the candidate if a predeclared larger both-side resolved window remains non-positive after stress costs or largest-winner removal, if short-side resolved evidence remains absent, or if exact path coverage cannot resolve the remaining prospective episodes without synthetic prices.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Keep MU report-only and preserve the frozen route while collecting exact prospective mark, depth, funding, and both-side exit evidence.
proposal_contract.why_now: Archive repair removed most technical censoring and exposed the actual economic issue: the positive aggregate is concentrated in one large long winner rather than a demonstrated bidirectional distribution.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: The immutable 408-decision and 64,575-book snapshot, 423,772 exact websocket marks, 4,199 audit-scoped exact 0xArchive repair marks, 214 protected archive files, official funding, measured fee evidence, stress friction, and the unchanged frozen lifecycle contract.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: MU produced two profitable and three losing resolved long lifecycles with positive aggregate PnL, but stress ex-largest is negative, one depth-incomplete long remains, and the sole short remains mark-path unresolved.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Evidence remains concentrated in 15m upward breakouts with EMA9 above EMA21 and positive depth-10 pressure; short-regime evidence is not economically resolved.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, long-only post-hoc promotion, parameter retuning, relaxed mark-gap standards, REST substitution, synthetic gap fills, and exact archive repair plus continued prospective capture. Only the last preserves the causal contract.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A larger exact both-side lifecycle sample can distinguish repeatable edge from one-outlier concentration without exposing v52 capital to an unqualified route.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Largest-winner dependence, one-sided selection, unresolved short path, incomplete entry depth, historical archive marks not proving live collector uptime, fees and funding erasing small gross wins, and next-observed-depth exits differing from venue fills.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: Onset identity reconciled 12 of 12; archive marks were used only in 14 audit-declared windows that independently passed the frozen 5-second bound; nominal and stress replay preserved signal, stop, fee, funding, latency, and one-position accounting; every consumed file was rehashed.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: A predeclared larger sample with resolved both-side lifecycles, exact live capture continuity, complete depth-sized entry and exit paths, untouched forward confirmation, and positive stress economics after largest-winner removal.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective onsets, at least 12 resolved lifecycle episodes with both sides represented, positive stress net and stress net excluding the largest winner, no synthetic path repair, and no unresolved source identity.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative stress or ex-largest lifecycle economics, persistent short-side absence, unresolved-path incidence remaining material, fee/funding drag exceeding the gross edge, or any evidence/hash/source mismatch.

limitations: Five of twelve prospective onsets become resolved portfolio lifecycles; five are overlap-suppressed and two remain technically censored.
All five completed lifecycles are long; the only short lifecycle remains mark-path unresolved.
Stress PnL becomes negative after removing the largest winner.
The largest winner contributes more than the total aggregate net PnL.
The remaining 0xArchive repair window contains a 60.815-second mark gap and was not used.
Historical exact archive marks repair risk-path evidence but do not prove prospective collector uptime.
Mark-triggered next-observed-depth exits are replay approximations rather than historical venue fills.
The stated sample sizes are investigation thresholds, not profitability or live-promotion gates.
No v52 strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
